reason: V1 requires writer disengaged before the time-zero pitch pluck but defines clay-force/relaxation features from 1–2 s. The disengaged inline writer cell measures its own unloaded port. Calibration cannot turn it into permanent clay-reaction force.
proposed_epoch: time zero is the end of the unchanged 21 s mechanical preparation history
force_feature_meaning: Measured engaged writer-port force before the read configuration changes; includes guide/fixture/clay contributions under qualified scope, not isolated clay stress or dissipation.
memoryless_covariates: Use qualified post-transfer pitch, temperature and plate position. Do not substitute the earlier write-stage geometry for current-state covariates.
transfer_requirement: Eight seconds is a proposal to qualify, not an achieved transition. Measure release, retraction, catch/rod-eye change, zero-load reconnection, gap checks and settling for every required condition. If it cannot fit, revise the core before development/confirmation rather than relabel time.
cost_changes_required: Postwrite disjoint components must total 30 s, replacing V1's fixed 20 s.
The transfer/settling interval is real time; assign its cost explicitly and identically across matched policies.
Charge the 31st second of recorded support to reset overhead; do not erase it from total cost.
Retain reset, calibration, computation, manual action and verification costs.
owner_actions_required: Review Hidden Math: decide on and version a physically compatible core, feature definitions, cost accounting and evaluator; keep V1 archived.
Physical build: qualify the actual transition, port identities, read disturbance, clock maps, natural-pitch estimator, action achievement and dynamic motion.
Freeze command hashes, extractor revision, predictors and schedule only after the revised physical binding is complete.
alternative: A separate qualified permanent clay-reaction force port can support the original temporal ordering, but it is a new hardware variant and is not supplied by the M04 inline writer cell.
evidence_boundary: The longer delay may erase fading history information. That is an experimental outcome, not grounds for moving windows after observing results.
